chapters: Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham jix gɨ' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam tu' na ja'p ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam aapi' oidha' gɨ' bopxi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook gu tukaa' suakɨt gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham juraa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx dha'; mi' dhɨr bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Judaa kuiñcha gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam juantu'n; gio ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp cham gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr bɨx jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sioon namki' na gu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch; gio ba' bɨx kiki'ñgob jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' juraa'n gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mo'o jix bɨɨx duu; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu jiim; mi' dhɨr a'aalh jix bɨɨx duu gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x vupui bhaan bhaamki'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' ka't mar u'vɨ gu Sioon bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' chiñia' jix bɨɨx duu na ja'p gu ñi'ook cham bakia' cham gu kavɨk vupui bhaan.

Na pai' dhuuk gu Jerusalem na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu novɨ bhaamki'ñdha' cham ka't u'ua'tɨdham tɨ'ñcho gu tanoolh bɨx tu'x gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix duñia' dɨr; gio ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' uañi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jerusalem; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x; na gu' bɨx gu ñi'ook jix duñia' na gu' xi'ɨraam; jano' ba' tu jiim.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' cham tɨ'ñcho; na ba' tu' jix duñia' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim cham juraa'n nuukdaidha'; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na gu' bhaamki'ñdha' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ bhaamki'ñdha' bɨx tu'x a'bhar; gio ba' tu' buupui baakɨi xidhuu chɨbɨɨp cham ba'k.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu takarui' tu jiim; gio ba' jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jugi bɨx tu'x a'bhar na ba' kapbhai' gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' dhi'.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt gu Mirad tu' cham tu'x jai'ch na ja'p tu' tɨbiap; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia' gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook i'iich.
Jano' ba' dɨr jix bhai'x bhañ gu tai o'oo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' jix vɨgɨ tɨɨt jix dhaas bɨɨx tas jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ jix duñia' bhaan; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr dhagia' gu Jawatan gu noobh bhaan cham.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx jix kavɨk tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'; gio ba' jup tɨɨt bhaan tu' chu'p na ba' jix duñia' biipibop; mi' dhɨr na ja'p gu Jawatan tu' gu Jawatan gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' kuiñcha tu' suanda'; gio ba' gu vupui gu suudai'; na gu' jix duñia' tu' nuukdaidha' jix maa jɨɨpi'ñka' gu i'ii'ñ; na gu' gu ma'nkam na gu' bhaamki'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' gu Sioon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu noobh cham juraa'n; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Jakob gu ñi'ook mia'n; mi' dhɨr gu Jerusalem ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jir bhai'; na tu' bhaan gu chin gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' jano' gu ja'tkam bɨx; jano' ba' biipibop jix bɨɨx duu.
Jano' ba' tu' jiiñak dha' gu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan daraa kiicham gu ñi'ook jugi na ba' bɨɨx kapbhai' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios dhi'; gio ba' ba'k gu i'ii'ñ bhaan tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'; na gu'; jano' ba' mai' gu ñi'ook koi'm.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham cham tu'x jai'ch nuukdaidha' na ba' tu'; gio ba' bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' naak cham bhai' jix duñia' tu'; mi' dhɨr jix duu jix ai gu tanoolh jix duñia' ka't na ja'p tu'.
Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan tu' bɨx tu' na cham jir bhai' gu vupui bɨɨx na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx; na gu' mui'x gu i'ii'ñ gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan i'iich mar u'vɨ gu Sioon gu Derriboo gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' gu Israeel cham tɨ'ñcho dhaibu' tɨɨt gu tanoolh daak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan cham; gio ba' i'iich bɨx vaak zel gu Jakob; mi' dhɨr gu oidha' mar u'vɨ gu Judaa oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' chiñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx i'iich gu ñi'ook bɨx gu Israeel; gio ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook kɨɨ'n vupui bhaan bhaamki'ñdha'; mi' dhɨr gu Jakob na ja'p mɨmɨim gu tai tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na ja'p bhaamki'ñdha' gu novɨ tu jiim na ja'p mu'aa bɨx ñiata; gio ba' vaak zel mar u'vɨ gu Sioon ja'aa na ja'p gu tai.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Jawatan na ja'p bhaamki'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel; gio ba' bɨx; mi' dhɨr jix mui' mar u'vɨ gu Judaa ɨlhdha'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak zel na ja'p u'uu pai' pai'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Sioon tas na jix bhaan tu' jix bhai'x i'iich daak gu gɨ'kora' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan xidhuu tu' dhagia' gu novɨ bhaamki'ñdha' vaak jodai; gio ba' jix maa gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham tu' duu vaak jodai mar u'vɨ gu Sioon; gio ba' cham gu novɨ cham tu' duu; mi' dhɨr jix duu vaak jodai; jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu bɨɨma'n.

Jano' ba' kiki'ñgob jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' jix duñia'; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' chiñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp pai' cham cham tu'x jai'ch ñi'ook na tu a'ga; mi' dhɨr jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix dhadhaa gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daraa mar u'vɨ gu Sioon; gio ba' oo' bhaan ɨɨbhidham; mi' dhɨr gu Jerusalem tɨsaa'ñdhak ɨɨbhidham gu oidha'.
Na pai' dhuuk gu vupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam suakɨt ba'k gu tanoolh na jix bhai' ja'aa gu oidha' mar u'vɨ gu ja'tkam na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook kiicham.
Jano' ba' am:―Ja'pji naana'n; gio ba' duukat tiriik suudai' u'va gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p kiicham gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ naana'n.

Na gu' gu ñi'ook ñi'ookdham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨkka tu' nɨidhim mar u'vɨ gu Jerusalem chɨkka tu' ua'rgidhai na ba' gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu Sioon na gu' jix gɨ' na ja'p gu gɨ' suudai'; gio ba' chɨkka tu'.
Jano' ba' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' tu' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham uañi'ñ na ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook tu' nɨnɨi'ñ.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt gu noobh bhaan tu'; gio ba' jix duñia' ɨɨbhidham bhaan mar u'vɨ gu Jerusalem bham; mi' dhɨr kiicham am:―Ja'pji bɨx gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' gu chin jix duñia' tu jiim; gio ba' gui'p; mi' dhɨr; jano' ba' tɨɨda' gu tanoolh; gio ba' gaagam.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook ga'ra' gu tanoolh na jix bhai' tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook ka't jix duñia' dɨr gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' bhaan tu' bhaamki'ñdha'.

Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan; gio ba' gu ñi'ook vaak jodai mar u'vɨ gu Sioon gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim suakɨt na ja'p jix duu gu tanoolh gu tukaa'; mi' dhɨr cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu vupui.

Jano' ba' bamii' jix maa jiiñak gu tukaa' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam jix duñia'; gio ba' biiñ na ja'p gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ vupui bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan; mi' dhɨr gu noobh gu oidha' pu'ñix bhiogi' ba'k bɨx.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chɨkka gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' jugi gu u'vɨ gu i'bhɨ pu'ñix gu an koko'kam xidhuu gu Jawatan jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.
Jano' ba' a'aalh kɨklhi'ñga'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha'; gio ba' biipibop ia'rɨ; mi' dhɨr gu tanoolh i'iich cham.
Jano' ba' tɨɨgim na ja'p gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam choo'n; gio ba' gu tanoolh i'iich gu Jawatan Dios cham ka't tu' juruuñdhai gu ñi'ook; na bhaamki'ñdha' jix bɨɨx duu.
Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu chio'ñ tu' buupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tukgam gu' cham gu tasi'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bhaan tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ bɨx gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chuukug zel; gio ba' jix duñia' o'oo.

Jano' ba' jix duu baakɨi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam taatam bɨɨx jix bhaan dhaas maatai.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk nɨɨra gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chɨ'ñchoka' gu i'ii'ñ na gu' tu'.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu Jawatan Dios cham gu'ch na gu' cham pai' dhuuk xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch.
Jano' ba' jix vɨɨk gu xibh; gio ba' jix gɨ' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Ba' jix aa' baasɨ'n gu Jawatan Dios gu i'ii'ñ; na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix bhai' gu chio'ñ tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chin oo' tu' cham tu'x jai'ch nɨɨra.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' va'k tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio gu ñi'ook bhaan xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch.
Na gu' na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu i'ii'ñ gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tɨɨt bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ vupui bhaan gu Altiisimo.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu chio'ñ kuiñcha gu Jawatan cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' chɨkka ka't mii' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam suudai' u'va gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan cham jix aa'ñdhix.
Jano' ba' gu chin gu Altiisimo cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bhai' jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook vaak jodai gu chio'ñ na jix do'ig gu chio'ñ uañi'ñ.

Jano' ba' no'ch gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daak; gio ba' cham.

Jano' ba' bɨx obhɨɨ'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan no'ch gu chin.
Jano' ba' choo'n jix duñia' ka't na ba' no'ch gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai' gu vupui mar u'vɨ gu ja'tkam.
Na gu' gu vupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham na gu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr gu tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' gu vupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ bɨx ma'nkam u'uuvɨ kiicham.
Jano' ba' obhɨɨ'ñ jix maa gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu u'uvhig cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' jix dhaas gu jodai bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook tɨɨtɨs bhaan mo'o; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix koi jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios dɨr kuupa'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham naak tu ñi'ook na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh tu'; gio ba' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham jum i'obh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan kuiñcha gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' tu' buupui gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' kuiñcha.
Jano' ba' tu' buupui bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨx bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' naak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨx bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook bhaan tu' jix búup gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' bɨx gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jix búup gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu ñi'ook gu noobh.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu i'ii'ñ mu'ai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam i'iich bɨtaa'n gu tɨkɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' jix bhai'x jix uam jodai gu Koomo jix bhai' jix uam jodai tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai xidhuu bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sioon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix uam jodai na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook bhi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu noobh.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix buusñi gu Dan gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' mar u'vɨ gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu u'uuv oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' nɨɨn gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu takarui' cham ka't.
Na jugi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bɨɨx duu; na jix duu jix duñia' dhi'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu ja'tkam uañi'ñ gu Sodoma ka't bhaan cham bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu Nasareos jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jabook bii'm jodai na jix tɨkɨr.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam duñia'; gio ba' cham; mi' dhɨr zel o'oo jix gaki na ja'p.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook jix bɨɨx duu koko'kam bhiogi'; na gu' suulhgia' jix koko' uañi'ñ gu i'bhɨ gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu noobh gu u'vɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu jugi mar u'vɨ gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios ja'aa gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tai gu Sioon.
Jano' ba' cham pai' dhuuk gu gɨ'kora' gu oidha' tu' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oipichu' jɨɨ'ñ bhaamki'ñdha' ba'k kiki'ñgob gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan tu' na cham jir bhai' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ɨ'ɨr jir bhai' ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p ñiññia jix bɨɨx duu gu ɨ'ɨr cham kuichdha'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Apartaos gu ñi'ook cham; na pai' dhuuk jiboi'ññor jix bɨɨx duu gui'p tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp; mi' dhɨr cham pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' daak gu Jawatan Dios jix ai'chdhix cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' cham gu vupui jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan tu' chooto'n jix duñia' kɨklhi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu vupui bhaan chulhiiñdha' jix duñia'; gio ba' nɨɨra gu oi'ñga'n gio gu suudai' gu ja'tkam cham jɨ'xdha' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook cham gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook chulhiiñdha' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh; na gu' chulhiiñdha' gu ñi'ook suudai' u'va.
